_about: 1-Propanol (1) + Methanol (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 93.32 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: H. Matsuda, M. Fukano, S. Kikkawa, D. Constantinescu, K. Kurihara, K. Tochigi, K. Ochi, J. Gmehling, Ebulliometric determination and prediction of (vapor + liquid) equilibria for binary and ternary mixtures containing alcohols (C1 C4) and dimethyl carbonate, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 44 (2012) 84-96
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.25 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
